01 The Challenge

Fragmented data. Delayed decisions in the service bay.

Dealership service managers and operations directors were juggling multiple disconnected tools: legacy parts management databases, standalone warranty claims, and static monthly spreadsheets.

Because diagnostic vehicle telemetry wasn’t integrated into daily operational scheduling, dealerships frequently faced unexpected part shortages, delayed vehicle turnaround times, and blind spots in overall fleet maintenance trends.

The objective: create a unified, real-time command center that translates complex vehicle telematics into immediate, confident operational action.
